audience: Gravel, adventure, touring and bikepacking riders who want the most refined, precise version of a bamboo build — and who'd rather drop into pre-formed lugs than free-wrap every joint by hand.

positioning.title: The lugged gravel frame, built right the first time.
positioning.lede: Our step-up gravel kit swaps free-hand carbon wrapping for pre-formed aluminium lugs the bamboo simply bonds into — cleaner joints, more repeatable geometry and a more refined finish. Same adventure-ready gravel geometry, built to the most precise, durable standard we make.

who_for.title: The precision-minded builder
who_for.body: You want joints that look and sit exactly right. Lugs locate every tube to a fixed angle, so geometry comes out repeatable and true with less room for free-hand error.

who_for.title: The weekend-pressed first-timer
who_for.body: Pre-formed lugs mean far less wrapping, so the build drops to 15–25 hours — the most approachable route into a real gravel frame, with one overnight cure.

who_for.title: The long-haul adventurer
who_for.body: Tour, bikepack and load it up. Lugged joints are cleaner to inspect and a tube can be replaced at the lug rather than re-wrapped from scratch — reassuring for big, remote miles.

faq.q: What does "lugged" mean, and how is it different from the standard gravel kit?
faq.a: Instead of free-wrapping every joint with carbon-fibre tow, the bamboo tubes bond into pre-formed aluminium lugs — sockets that hold each tube at a fixed angle. You get cleaner, more precise joints, more repeatable geometry and a more refined finish. It's the premium step up from the standard carbon-wrapped gravel kit.

faq.q: Is the lugged kit easier or harder to build?
faq.a: Easier, and faster. The lugs locate the tubes for you and there's far less wrapping, so the build is 15–25 hours versus 25–40 for the standard gravel kit — with just one overnight cure. It's our most beginner-friendly route into a full gravel frame.

faq.q: Is a lugged frame as strong as the wrapped one?
faq.a: Yes. Bamboo gives ~28,000 PSI tensile strength — comparable to mild steel — and we've seen under a 1% failure rate across 4,000+ builds since 2012, with the design tested at Swansea University. Finished frames last 8–12 years with proper care.

faq.q: Can I still repair it down the line?
faq.a: Lugged construction is the more repairable option: because each tube bonds into its own lug socket, a damaged tube can be replaced at the joint rather than rebuilding a hand-wrapped union from scratch — handy if you tour or bikepack hard.
No. Just basic hand tools — a hacksaw, files, sandpaper, a measuring tape and a work surface around 1200 × 600 mm. The lugs, bamboo, epoxy, jig and 15+ hours of video tutorials are all in the kit.
